body.statement: The product-uniform prior is supported on the bounded-TV schedule class: \(\Pi_{\mathrm{unif}}(\mathcal Y_{M,\Gamma})=1\) for every admissible drift budget \(\Gamma\).
body.justification: A least-favorable prior is valid only if every realized schedule obeys the fixed-population restrictions pathwise.
body.gap: The parent lacked a diffuse schedule-supported prior whose legality and adaptive likelihood could both be checked directly.
body.consumer: The admissibility certificate lets the prior-averaged coverage inequality lower-bound the original fixed-schedule minimax problem.
